problem: Prove that BeBee can add a third authored region with a clear wetland identity while reusing the validated movement-through pollination, Honey, Flight/Buzz, restoration, save and analytics systems, without adding a new verb, currency, mandatory spend, lethal hazard or per-region world lifecycle.

decision.rationale: The exact-head deterministic and Chromium journey validates Wetland Garden as region_03 in the same continuous authored world. Four new Meadows complete through the existing movement-through pollination verb, reuse Honey and Buzz 3, reload through save v4, and retain the six-slot nearby-patch pool. Water, roots and islands provide identity as non-lethal navigation language. The earlier 2040-byte view_state failure was repaired by omitting transient qualifying=false values for inactive patches; the accepted head passes the full browser/evidence job without raising the GUI or patch budgets. The independent evaluation accepts the architecture with the existing explicit geometric-art deviation; P7 remains IN PROGRESS for later authored regions and release-art polish.

governance.trust_boundary_change: No governance-critical file, workflow, validator, ruleset, permission or trust-boundary behavior is changed by this player-facing slice. The manifest is ordinary same-PR feature evidence.
governance.bypass_analysis: No governance bypass is introduced or used. Exact-head CI, trusted evidence policy, diff classification, deterministic tests and retained artifacts remain the authority for this PR.
governance.rollback: Revert this feature PR to remove the Wetland content and bounds changes; no repository enforcement setting or separate migration is required because save v4 and the existing adapters remain authoritative.

selected_references.name: Loddlenaut / aquatic ecological recovery
selected_references.selection_reason: Closest selected reference for giving an aquatic ecology setting a recognizable identity while preserving a small familiar interaction vocabulary.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Aquatic areas communicate ecological recovery through environment, habitat and friendly-life presentation; the setting changes while basic movement and cleanup remain readable.
selected_references.inference: Wetland should use water, roots, islands and recovered life as environmental language, while pollination remains the only restoration verb and water never becomes a damage system.

selected_references.name: Alba / authored habitat landmarks
selected_references.selection_reason: Useful reference for compact low-pressure authored spaces where local habitat silhouettes and landmarks orient the player without a world-management screen.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Natural spaces are differentiated by habitat context, landmarks and wildlife rather than requiring a dense HUD or separate strategic layer for each area.
selected_references.inference: Lotus Landing, Iris Channel, Rootwalk Isles and Dragonfly Basin should be readable through layout, flower silhouettes, water/root landmarks and restoration reveal while retaining the sparse objective/Honey HUD.

anti_pattern.observation: Terra Nil makes restoration a region-specific strategic transformation loop with management decisions, buildings, resources and biome conversion.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not use Wetland as a reason to add water-level simulation, purification/building tools, wetland currency, a region-management screen or procedural generation; those would replace the validated BeBee loop instead of scaling authored content.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Collection proxies create separate game-world lifecycle surfaces; Wetland has no measured need for one proxy per region or Meadow and remains in the continuous gameplay world.
Collection factories can add content to the current world; the selected authored data path avoids introducing a new per-region lifecycle before lifecycle or memory evidence requires it.

Defold GUI scenes have Current Nodes and Max Nodes budgets. The earlier HTML5 run exceeded the 2040-byte msg.post buffer while the accepted implementation bounds visible patch state and omits inactive transient fields.
Runtime resource and node usage must be measured and bounded; the accepted browser run retains PATCH_POOL_SIZE=6 and max_nodes=512 rather than hiding content growth by raising limits.

alternatives.reason: Adds the requested wetland content and traversal bounds while preserving the proven verb, save, analytics, current-world lifecycle and visible-complexity cap; exact-head Chromium evidence passes.
No independent lifecycle or memory requirement was measured, and per-region proxies would multiply lifecycle and input/focus surfaces.
Water-level, purification, building or wetland-specific economy would add a new strategic system and violate the slice scope.
Would mask total-catalog growth instead of repairing transient state serialization and bounded presentation.
The validated BeBee world remains authored for pacing, landmarks and deterministic evidence; procedural generation is outside this content slice.
